assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9004 has Priority: Major. summary-comment.md documents: '**Priority**: `Major` -- propagated from Feature TC-9004 to all created tasks via `additional_fields.priority`' (line 27). The additional_fields JSON block (lines 34-39) includes '"priority": {"name": "Major"}'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9004 has fixVersions: RHTPA 1.5.0 (non-empty). CLAUDE.md has no '### Jira Field Defaults' section, so fixVersion scope defaults to 'both'. summary-comment.md documents: '**fixVersions**: `RHTPA 1.5.0` -- propagated from Feature TC-9004 to all created tasks via `additional_fields.fixVersions` (no `fixVersion scope` restriction found in Jira Field Defaults, defaulting to "both")' (line 28). The additional_fields JSON includes '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.5.0"}]'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
